unitTitle: The Imperative - Reflexive Pronouns - Might/Could - Must/Have to - Can/Be allowed to - Could/Couldn't

pairsWith.noteUz: Buyruq mayli va o'zlik olmoshlari mashqlari.

scanNote:
GRAMMAR 2, 10-UNIT MAShQLAR (51-bet, PDF 50). Yuqorida o'ngda ko'k '10'.

CHAP USTUN - 'The Imperative':
1) 'Fill in the gaps with one of the verbs from the list using the correct form of the imperative, as in the example.' yell, bring, raise, leave, try, type, be, pick. SURATLAR: 1 baqirayotgan bola - Don't yell! Your brother is sleeping. 2 bobo va bola kompyuterda - ...... your name. 3 zinadagi sumkalar - ...... your schoolbags on the steps! Someone might fall over them. 4 doskada qo'l ko'targan ayol - ...... your hand if you have a question. 5 velosipedda bola - ...... careful. You might fall. 6 plyajda odam va it - ...... me the frisbee, boy. 7 bola gullar orasida - ...... the flowers! The gardener will get angry. 8 do'konda ko'ylak - ...... this T-shirt on. Blue suits you.

O'NG USTUN - 'Reflexive pronouns':
2) 'Fill in the gaps with the correct reflexive pronoun.' RASMLAR: 1 ayol qog'ozlar orasida - She had to do all the work by ...... . 2 kompyuter - He taught ...... how to use a computer. 3 shifokor va bemor - Next time you should take better care of ...... . 4 oila stolda - Tom can't do his maths homework by ...... . 5 ikki kishi qo'l berishyapti - Let me introduce ...... . My name is Brad Farris. 6 raqs tushayotgan juftlik - Mary and Ted enjoyed ...... at the party.
3) 'Fill in the blanks with the correct reflexive pronoun.' 1 A: That's a beautiful painting. Where did you get it? B: I painted it 1) ...... A: What! You painted that 2) ......! I didn't know you could paint. B: My mother is a painter. She taught 3) ...... how to paint and she also taught me. 2 A: You've got a lovely house. B: Thank you. Vanessa and I designed it 1) ...... . A: Did you design Susie and Jenny's room too? B: No, the girls designed and decorated it 2) ...... .

Bet raqami: pastda o'ngda '51'.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the gaps with one of the verbs from the list using the correct form of the imperative, as in the example. Pictures: 1 a boy yelling; 2 grandfather and boy at a computer; 3 schoolbags on the steps; 4 teacher raising her hand; 5 boy on a bike; 6 man and dog on the beach; 7 boy in the flowers; 8 T-shirt in a shop.
exercises.instructionUz: Bo'shliqlarni ro'yxatdagi fe'llardan biri bilan buyruq maylining to'g'ri shaklida to'ldiring, namunadagidek. Rasmlar: 1 baqirayotgan bola; 2 bobo va bola kompyuterda; 3 zinadagi sumkalar; 4 qo'l ko'targan o'qituvchi; 5 velosipedda bola; 6 plyajda odam va it; 7 gullar orasidagi bola; 8 do'kondagi futbolka.
exercises.explanationUz:
BUYRUQ: FE'L / DON'T + FE'L.

  1 DON'T YELL (NAMUNA - inkor)
  2 TYPE your name (kompyuter)
  3 DON'T LEAVE your schoolbags
    (inkor - xavfli)
  4 RAISE your hand
  5 BE careful
  6 BRING me the frisbee
  7 DON'T PICK the flowers (inkor)
  8 TRY this T-shirt on


⚠ 'TO YELL':

  = baqirmoq.


⚠ 'TO FALL OVER':

  = qoqilib yiqilmoq.


⚠ 'BLUE SUITS YOU':

  = ko'k rang senga yarashadi.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the gaps with the correct reflexive pronoun.
exercises.instructionUz: Bo'shliqlarni to'g'ri o'zlik olmoshi bilan to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
EGAGA QARANG.

  1 She → by HERSELF (o'zi, yolg'iz)
  2 He → HIMSELF
  3 you → YOURSELF
  4 Tom → by HIMSELF
  5 Let me → MYSELF
  6 Mary and Ted → THEMSELVES


⚠ 'BY + O'ZLIK OLMOShI':

  = yolg'iz, o'zi (yordamsiz):
  'by herself' = o'zi yolg'iz.


⚠ 'TO TAKE CARE OF YOURSELF':

  = o'ziga g'amxo'rlik qilmoq.


⚠ 'LET ME INTRODUCE MYSELF':

  = o'zimni tanishtirishga ruxsat
  bering.

items.textEn: She had to do all the work by ___.
He taught ___ how to use a computer.
Next time you should take better care of ___.
Tom can't do his maths homework by ___.
Let me introduce ___. My name is Brad Farris.
Mary and Ted enjoyed ___ at the party.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the blanks with the correct reflexive pronoun.
exercises.instructionUz: Bo'shliqlarni to'g'ri o'zlik olmoshi bilan to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
DIALOGLARDA O'ZLIK OLMOShLARI.

  1-DIALOG:
  I painted it MYSELF (o'zim)
  You painted that YOURSELF!
  She taught HERSELF how to paint
  (o'zi o'rgangan)

  2-DIALOG:
  Vanessa and I designed it
  OURSELVES (o'zimiz)
  the girls designed it THEMSELVES


⚠ URG'U MA'NOSI:

  'I painted it MYSELF' = o'zim
  chizdim (boshqa emas) - urg'u.

patterns.exampleEn: Don't yell! Your brother is sleeping. Don't pick the flowers! The gardener will get angry.

patterns.exampleUz: U barcha ishni yolg'iz qilishga majbur bo'ldi. Tom uy vazifasini o'zi qila olmaydi.

patterns.formula: Let me introduce myself. My name is ...
patterns.exampleEn: Let me introduce myself. My name is Brad Farris.
